content.short: Wildcat is a borrower-led on-chain credit protocol, letting borrowers create and define markets.
content.description: Wildcat addresses the lack of borrower-led, undercollateralized credit options in DeFi. By enabling borrowers to create and customize their own credit markets, it removes the need for off-chain agreements and traditional lender-first models. Lenders can review markets and choose those that match their risk appetite.
